_comment: Sessions where Welsh tunes are played, for the Sessions page (sesiynau/). Each: venue, address, town (town_cy if its Welsh name differs), county (a Welsh principal area in English, or "Outside Wales"), lat, lon, day (Monday … Sunday), repeat ("weekly"; "fortnightly", with from: the date of one it meets on; or "monthly" with nth: 1-4, or -1 for the last; or "dates" for a session on announced dates, with dates: ["2026-10-22", …] in order and no day: add each new date as it's announced, and leave past ones in), start and end (24-hour "19:00"; end optional), and confirmed (the date someone last checked it's running as listed). Optional: kind ("tune club" for a club where people learn tunes together; a session otherwise), name (the session's own name), from and until (a season), music and music_cy (what's played), link (the session's or venue's page). Check a session again whenever someone writes in about it, and update confirmed.

sessions.name: Noson Lawen: Folk in the Bar
sessions.music: Welsh folk tunes and songs, in the café bar. Free; bring your fiddle, crwth, pibgorn or voice.
sessions.music_cy: Alawon a chaneuon gwerin Cymreig, ym mar y caffi. Am ddim; dewch â'ch ffidil, crwth, pibgorn neu lais.

sessions.music: Welsh folk night: bring an instrument and join in, or come and listen.
sessions.music_cy: Noson werin Gymreig: dewch ag offeryn i ymuno, neu dewch i wrando.

sessions.name: Sesiwn Werin Tŷ Tawe
sessions.music: Welsh tunes and songs, with the odd exception. At Swansea's Welsh-language centre, run by Menter Iaith Abertawe.
sessions.music_cy: Alawon a chaneuon Cymreig, gydag ambell eithriad. Yng nghanolfan Gymraeg Abertawe, dan ofal Menter Iaith Abertawe.

sessions.name: Sesiwn Fach Cwm Tawe
sessions.music: Come to learn and practise tunes from Wales. Run by Menter Iaith Castell-nedd Port Talbot (01639 763819, menter@micnpt.cymru).
sessions.music_cy: Dewch i ddysgu ac ymarfer alawon o Gymru. Dan ofal Menter Iaith Castell-nedd Port Talbot (01639 763819, menter@micnpt.cymru).

sessions.name: Aberystwyth Tune Club
sessions.music: Sharing and learning traditional Welsh folk tunes.
sessions.music_cy: Rhannu a dysgu alawon gwerin traddodiadol Cymreig.

sessions.name: Clwb Alawon y Tair
sessions.music: Welsh tunes and folk singing (canu gwerin).

sessions.name: Sesiwn Werin
sessions.music: Welsh tunes, mainly from the Alawon Sesiwn books, and some songs. The date sometimes changes: check their Facebook page.
sessions.music_cy: Alawon Cymreig, yn bennaf o lyfrau Alawon Sesiwn, ac ambell gân. Mae'r dyddiad yn newid weithiau: edrychwch ar eu tudalen Facebook.

sessions.address: Afan Road, Duffryn Rhondda, Port Talbot SA13 3ES
sessions.music: Traditional Welsh music: bring an instrument and join in, or just sit and enjoy the tunes and the energy.
sessions.music_cy: Cerddoriaeth Gymreig draddodiadol: dewch ag offeryn ac ymuno, neu eisteddwch a mwynhau'r alawon a'r egni.

sessions.name: Sesiwn Werin
sessions.music: Welsh folk session: come and sing, or jam with the Acordions Dros Annibyniaeth.
sessions.music_cy: Sesiwn werin Gymreig: dewch i ganu, neu i jamio efo'r Acordions Dros Annibyniaeth.

sessions.name: Sesiwn Conwy Folk
sessions.address: Snowdon Craft Beer, Unit 2, Vale Road, Llandudno Junction LL31 9SH
sessions.music: In The Laundry, the taproom of Snowdon Craft Beer (Bragdy Yr Wyddfa). Contact details through Conwy Fringe.
sessions.music_cy: Yn The Laundry, ystafell dap Bragdy Yr Wyddfa (Snowdon Craft Beer). Manylion cyswllt drwy Conwy Fringe.

sessions.music: Every Tuesday, more or less, not far from the pier. The start time varies: around 8pm, sometimes later. It ends when they close.
sessions.music_cy: Pob nos Fawrth, mwy neu lai, dim yn bell o'r pier. Mae'r amser dechrau'n amrywio: tua 8yh, weithiau'n hwyrach. Mae'n gorffen pan maen nhw'n cau.

sessions.name: Noson Werin y Fic
sessions.music: Trad session: Welsh, Breton, French and Scandinavian tunes.
sessions.music_cy: Sesiwn draddodiadol: alawon o Gymru, Llydaw, Ffrainc a Llychlyn.

sessions.address: Ffordd Rhiw Iâl, Llanarmon-yn-Iâl, Mold CH7 4QE

sessions.music_cy: Alawon a chaneuon Cymreig yn bennaf.
